axis_coverage.name: Original obligations and negative constraints
axis_coverage.assessment: The final provides a research proposal with mechanisms, implementation context, measurement/passive/operational comparisons, a useful no-purchase path and a staged traceable pilot. It preserves missing case facts and owner decisions. No safety/storage/shelf-life/compliance/suitability conclusion, routing build, present-shipment instruction or empirical local outcome appears. Negative action claims are preserved in authored records; complete external tool conduct is not independently audited.

axis_coverage.name: Consequential source claims and applicability
axis_coverage.assessment: Primary text confirms the consequential subject, operation, measurement type, historical version and transfer conditions. Codex attribution is corrected. 2022/2023 studies measure crate-near air, not tissue or quality; the apple cooling percentages and qualitative case population stay bounded. Abstract-only access, a compressed PCM result summary and the optional curtain locator are nonmaterial limits. No unsupported local efficacy/default/limit or purchased design remains.

axis_coverage.name: Useful unfamiliar discovery, alternatives, implementation/history and breadth
axis_coverage.assessment: The work is more than caution: it finds crop-matched biomimetic thermal sensing, contextualized distributed air sensing, conditioned PCM with finite reserve/reuse costs, historic placement/ventilation guidance and qualitative retrieval/accountability barriers. It compares measure-only, preconditioning, packaging, handling/route and powered feasibility paths. Local historical records are unavailable and correctly proposed for later investigation. Published deployment coverage lacks delivered-quality efficacy and cannot prove it; the proposal explicitly avoids such transfer.

axis_coverage.name: Wrong criticism, corrections/rejections and exact plan dispositions
axis_coverage.assessment: Every SCW-1–5 disposition was independently checked. SCW-1 is a supported minor attribution/coordinate amendment. SCW-2–5 retain existing supported limits rather than inventing errors. Missing cross-species/local evidence is kept undetermined, not used as an absence witness. SCW-3’s selected sentence exists in the draft’s mechanism section rather than its announced history locator: minor navigation defect, no semantic substitution. All exact original brief and additional plan clauses are adjudicated below; release/custody mechanics are kept separate as UNKNOWN where not evidenced.

axis_coverage.name: Supported meaning across discovery, draft, critique and final
axis_coverage.assessment: Measurement-first meaning, paired warm-zone/crate/product channels, passive and operational options, finite PCM scope, apple-specific surrogate qualification, local history questions, practical cost categories and future-only validation survive the full lineage. The final corrects Codex shorthand and sharpens air-endpoint wording; it does not discard top-position air monitoring, generic-surrogate possibilities pending validation or compatible route options. No material meaning is lost and no unsupported efficacy is added.

axis_coverage.name: Proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability
axis_coverage.assessment: The executed work is literature/package review and proposal writing, not data analysis or calibration. Proposed checks have discriminating roles: synchronized exposure/event channels, actual product readings at loading/receipt, qualified sensor response, validated crop-matched surrogate if used, partner-defined independent quality observations, repeated blocked/randomized shipment comparisons, uncertainty and actual costs. No supplied route, crop, trace, quality result or independent pilot oracle exists. Published air buffering and apple cooling tests cannot validate this case. Deferring sample size/thresholds until endpoints, variability and costs are known is an honest prerequisite, not vacuous caution.
